item.title: Filipino prelate warns brother bishops against ‘scandal’ of ‘lavish hospitality’
item.description: A senior Filipino prelate urged his brother bishops, during their recent plenary assembly, to keep their biannual meetings frugal to avoid the “scandal” of “accepting lavish hospitality” from their host dioceses.

item.title: Swiss politician fined for shooting a pistol at Madonna and Child poster
item.description: A Swiss politician was convicted Wednesday for firing a sport pistol at an auction poster of a 14th-century painting of Madonna and child and then posting images of the damage online.

item.title: ‘Christophobia’ bills seek to bar religious costumes in Brazil’s Carnival
item.description: Conservative members of city councils across Brazil have been introducing bills against what they call “Christophobia,” targeting especially participants in Carnival parades who satirize Christian symbols.

item.title: From Apartheid resistance to building bridges: South African Church’s 75-Year journey
item.description: Cardinal Stephen Brislin, Archbishop of the Catholic archdiocese of Johannesburg, has offered a reflection on on the Catholic Church in South Africa.

item.title: Pope tells Vatican office that processes sex abuse cases to uphold truth, justice and charity
item.description: Pope Leo XIV told the Vatican’s doctrine office on Thursday to uphold truth, justice and charity when deciding clergy sex abuse cases.

item.title: Church concerned about mass deportations of Haitians from the US
item.description: As Haitians are set to lose their Temporary Protected Status (TPS) on Feb. 3, around 330,000 refugees and immigrants are expected to be forced to leave the United States and return to their violence-plagued Caribbean nation.

item.title: New campaign calls on Mexicans to rediscover the capital’s heart through revered churches
item.description: La Profesa church in downtown Mexico City has endured through a tumultuous history.

item.title: Pope gets invitation to visit Peru during a Vatican garden party, then stays for lunch
item.description: Peru’s ambassador to the Holy See publicly invited Pope Leo XIV to visit his second homeland on Saturday, as 2026 is shaping up to be an important year for the pontiff's travel with big trips under study for Africa and South America.

item.title: Leo XIV’s remarks to Doctrine office give subtle signals
item.description: Leo XIV's remarks to the DDF on Thursday merit close reading and careful attention, both for the direction they set for the doctrine dicastery and for the terse message the pontiff offered regarding the process of justice in abuse cases.
